people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
translations.bsb: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
translations.kjv: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
translations.asv: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
